image_description: A teal/green street sign with white text mounted on a metal pole structure. The text appears to be in Hebrew and English, but the characters are heavily distorted, melted, and illegible. The background features a modern building with glass windows and concrete elements. The sign itself shows significant warping and structural anomalies where it attaches to the pole.

The sign has an unnatural curve and warp that defies rigid material physics. The background building lines also show slight inconsistency in perspective.
The surface lacks the sharp, clean edges of a manufactured sign, appearing slightly soft and painterly, especially around the lettering.
